prior_review.prior_finding: F1 labeled the wording a minor/non-blocking divergence and noted that the sample had no cross-year case.
prior_review.treatment: The prior severity label is not adopted as the result of this fresh, narrowly scoped adjudication.

adjudication.conclusion: The candidate does not state or guarantee the Blueprint's default year for a cross-year series. Its wording permits attribution under an actual closeout rule that could differ from the last year containing substantive teaching. The candidate also has compatible safeguards (actual teaching dates, one-year-only counting, rationale, reviewer, and no growth-driven changes). No REAL policy or cross-year event was available to prove that an actual record has already been misattributed.
rationale: The Blueprint makes the last year with substantive teaching activity the cross-year attribution rule, not merely an optional example.
The candidate delegates year assignment to an actual closeout rule without requiring that rule to match the Blueprint default or stating a fallback.
The sample ledger has no cross-year series, so its existing annual totals do not exercise this choice.
Therefore PASS is unsupported; PARTIAL captures the textual gap without claiming an unobserved REAL error.
